caption: The drawing depicts an ornate mirror with a circular reflective surface encased in a decorative golden frame featuring interlocking loops. On either side of the mirror, standing at the same height, are two female figurines with dark hair, each wearing long, tiered dresses—the left figure in brown, the right figure in dark green. Below the mirror, the frame branches into two large, symmetrical leaf-like shapes that extend outward, colored in shades of gray and black. At the base of these branches, there is a central triangular obelisk in dark brown, flanked on the left by a small American flag on a pole, and on the right by a green object resembling a sea serpent or dragon emerging from blue-green water. The flag has red and white stripes with a blue field and white stars. The base is formed by a metallic-looking pedestal featuring a stylized fluted shell motif in gold and dark brown. The entire composition is set against a plain, cream-colored background, and the artist’s name is written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Jenny Lind Mirror
